Königsberger Bridges Institute · Brand and identity

One institute, drawn as a blueprint.

Logos, colour, type, icons, favicon, social banners and business cards for KBI. Everything here follows the design system of the new kb.institute: Prussian-blue ground, drafting grid, cyan for live elements, gold for the one call to action.

MarksBlatt 2 / 8

The mark and two lockups.

Three peaks drawn as one line, with bridges crossing at the base. Use the light version on the blueprint ground and the Prussian-blue version on paper and light documents.

To approve

These are the first SVG versions of the KBI logo. They are traced from the mark and the vector wordmark in “Logo KBI 2026 (500x500).pdf” and match the original to 99.9 % of pixels. Please confirm them before they replace the PNG files on Drive.

Clear space and minimum size

  • x
    Clear spaceKeep at least x free on every side, where x is the height of the smallest inner triangle (about a fifth of the mark's width b).
  • 24
    Minimum sizeMark 24 px wide on screen, 8 mm in print. Horizontal lockup 140 px or 30 mm, so the wordmark stays readable.
  • 1:1
    Never redrawUse these files. The wordmark is a different bold geometric sans from the site's type; never retype it.

The seven bridges

Each directorate owns one bridge, one Roman numeral and one colour. Use bridge colours for emblems, tags and graph edges, never for body text or large fills.

TypeBlatt 4 / 8

Three families, all free on Google Fonts.

A technical sans for titles, a matching sans for reading, and a mono for labels, figures and anything inside a drawing.

Three olympiads. One method.Barlow Semi Condensed · 500, 600Headings, program codes, names. Sentence case.
Prepare humanity for unknown unknowns through continuous innovation.Barlow · 400, 500, 600Running text, at most 68 characters a line.
Olympiads · Blatt 2 / 7 · 10,000IBM Plex Mono · 500, 600Labels, navigation, tags, dates, figures. Labels uppercase with 0.12em tracking.
IconsBlatt 5 / 8

Programs and domains.

Line glyphs in the same grammar as the site's pillar icons: a 44-unit grid, 1.5 stroke, filled nodes, square ends. The SVGs use currentColor, so they take the colour of the text around them. Default is cyan.

Program badges

FaviconBlatt 6 / 8

The light mark on a Prussian-blue square.

The full mark at every size. At 16 px its inner lines merge, but it still reads as KBI's triangle. The maskable icon keeps the mark inside Android's safe circle.

Put the files in the site root, then add this to every page's head

SocialBlatt 7 / 8

Banners for eight channels.

Each banner is a drawing sheet: the KBI mission, the lockup, and Euler's graph or the plan of Königsberg from the homepage hero. Everything important sits inside the platform's safe area.

Blueprint front, paper back.

The front carries the lockup and a half-timbered house in elevation. The back is white with Prussian-blue ink, so it prints sharp and people can write on it.

RulesAnhang

Keep the drawing true.

Do
  • Use the light logo on blue and the Prussian-blue logo on paper.
  • Quote the vision and mission word for word.
  • Write Canadian English: organization, program, colour, centre.
  • Keep one bold moment per piece: the graph, the plan or the mark.
  • Label drawings with German drafting terms: Grundriss, Aufriss, Blatt, Massstab.
Don't
  • Redraw, stretch, outline or recolour the mark.
  • Retype the wordmark in Barlow or any other font.
  • Use bridge colours for body text or large fills.
  • Add glitch, scanline or noise effects, photos or emoji.
  • Invent measurements on drawings. They stay “Massstab: ohne”.

Open items

  1. Approve the SVG logos. They are traces of the Canva files, not master artwork from KBI's designer.
  2. Phone and address for cards. The sample shows placeholders until you confirm them.
  3. Card size for Hong Kong. 85 × 55 mm is the EU size. Hong Kong printers often use 90 × 54 mm.
  4. German vision and mission. Still drafts, so all banners are in English for now.
  5. Chinese name for KBI. WeChat, Weibo and Bilibili use English text, as no official Chinese name was available.
